title: Double Drip Super Berry Sherbet E-Liquid 10ml
description: Double Drip’s Super Berry Sherbet is an impossibly juicy blend of ripe British berries dusted in a glittering layer of sweet, sugary sherbet. This delectable delight promises billowing clouds bursting with zingy, zesty deliciousness, with the tart taste of strawberries, blackberries, raspberries and blueberries sprawling lavishly over your taste buds with every inhale! This handy 10ml bottle is ideal for vaping on the go, fitting perfectly into your bag or pocket for a sweet treat any time of the day which tends to your nicotine cravings and your sweet tooth in equal measures! Double Drip Coil Sauce E-Liquid is a high-quality vape juice brand proudly manufactured right here in the United Kingdom. Browse the entire Double Drip range and find the perfect juice for your e-cigarette setup. Double Drip is available in a variety of formulations to suit a range of kits, including sub ohm (high-VG), 50/50 e-liquid , nicotine salt vape juice , and 50ml shortfills for use with starter vape kits , high-powered e cig kits, compact pod vape kits and pen vape kits .
